cluster_summary: This cluster comprises 16 CVEs that all involve insufficient validation or sanitization of user-controlled input before it is used in critical operations such as shell command execution, subprocess argument construction, filesystem path operations, and output rendering. The vulnerabilities manifest as command injection, argument injection, path traversal, credential disclosure, ANSI escape injection, and regex bypass, but they share a common deficiency in treating untrusted input as safe in different contexts.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Obfuscate or remove credentials from Git URLs before writing to output, add configuration to disable inclusion of Git info by default, and reorder operations to avoid including sensitive data in iterated collections..

mechanism.typical_fix: Obfuscate or remove credentials from Git URLs before writing to output, add configuration to disable inclusion of Git info by default, and reorder operations to avoid including sensitive data in iterated collections.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Obfuscate or remove credentials from Git URLs before writing to output, add configuration to disable inclusion of Git info by default, and reorder operations to avoid including sensitive data in iterated collections.
sub_patterns.name: Sensitive Data Exposure in Metadata Output
sub_patterns.root_cause: Credentials embedded in Git remote URLs are included in metadata dumps or test reports without sanitization, because the code assumes these URLs are safe to include or does not consider them sensitive.
